risk_summary: The company reports substantial ongoing losses, no product revenue, a $101.1 million accumulated deficit, and cash runway only through the end of 2020, indicating significant financing and going-concern risk. Clinical and regulatory outcomes remain highly uncertain, with repeated conditional language and dependence on positive trial results, FDA agreement, and additional funding. Development of two programs has been narrowed or discontinued, while NPS requires an out-licensing partner for future Phase 3 development.
